subject: general
question: Which of the following is a factor of the polynomial x² – x – 20?
solution:
GIVEN:

Polynomial = x2 - x - 20 

CALCULATION:

Here, we have x2 - x - 20 = 0 

⇒ x2 - 5x + 4x - 20 = 0 

⇒ x(x - 5) + 4 (x - 5) = 0 

⇒ (x + 4) (x - 5) = 0 

Hence, the factors are (x + 4) and (x - 5 ) 

Since (x + 4) is not the option. So, (x - 5) is the factor of the polynomial

Hence, a factor of the polynomial x2 - x - 20 is (x - 5).
